kb_articles.title: Refund policy
kb_articles.body: Duplicate charges are refunded to the customer's account on file. Refunds above $100 need a supervisor's approval.

kb_articles.title: Plans and upgrades
kb_articles.body: Customers can see their plan in Settings > Billing. Upgrades take effect immediately and are prorated.

kb_articles.title: Contacting a customer
kb_articles.body: Reply to customers only at the email address on file for their account.
